name: 5-fluoro-MET
summary: Bretisilocin, also known by its developmental code name GM-2505 and as 5-fluoro-N-methyl-N-ethyltryptamine (5F-MET or 5-fluoro-MET), is a serotonergic psychedelic of the tryptamine family which is under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder. It is an analogue of dimethyltryptamine (DMT) and is the 5-fluorinated derivative of methylethyltryptamine (MET).
